name: IntuneManagement
description: A PowerShell application with WPF GUI for managing Microsoft Intune and Azure policies. Features export, import, copy, delete, document, and compare operations across 30+ object types with cross-tenant migration, ADMX import, bulk operations, and automated documentation.
author: Micke Karlsson

securityCheck.aiSummary: Overall assessment: The CloudAPIPowerShellManagement module appears to be a legitimate Intune/Graph management utility with no obfuscated code, no remote code execution from URLs, and no hardcoded secrets. The primary security concern is handling of credentials (tenantId, appId, secret, certificate) in plaintext within global variables. This memory-resident exposure could be mitigated by adopting secure credential handling (PSCredential, SecureString, managed identities, or certificate vaults) and avoiding global storage. Confirm that all loaded modules come from trusted sources, and implement robust access controls and auditing for UI-driven operations.
